interpretation: The descriptive one-third/triple additions are canonically safe on the full 664-track GiantSteps corpus: zero output invariance failures and zero timing-tier changes.
They do not improve GiantSteps candidate reference recall: overall recall remains 648/664 and triple-family recall remains 7/10.
The three triple-family misses are not evidence of a transform-construction bug; their references differ by more than 4 percent from the exact one-third/3x transform of the selected tempo.
Runtime impact is effectively neutral on average.
This gate is regression/safety evidence, not independent proof that the triple relations should become primary tactus selections.
next_gate: Develop and evaluate a new deterministic multi-window accent/grouping diagnostic for choosing among existing tactus candidates, with no genre hard-coding. Validate on real meter-labeled holdout audio before any promotion decision.
